how_to_apply: Applications for the Mayiladuthurai DHS Staff Nurse posts are offline only and must reach the District Health Office by 4 December 2026, 5:00 PM.
Download the application form from the Mayiladuthurai District Collector website (mayiladuthurai.nic.in, Recruitment notice category).
Attach copies of the documents listed below to the application.
Send the application by Speed Post or Registered Post, or hand it in directly in person.
Address the application to: District Health Office, 7th Floor, District Collectorate Complex, Mannampandal, Mayiladuthurai-609305.
Make sure the application reaches the office between 20 November 2026 and 4 December 2026, 5:00 PM.
Degree/diploma mark sheet (GNM / B.Sc. Nursing Mark Sheet)
Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Registration Certificate (a TNNMC certificate valid before the date of publication of the notice is compulsory)
Residence proof (Aadhaar card, family card, voter identity card)
Transgender / Ex-servicemen / Destitute widow certificate (if any)
important_instructions: The Staff Nurse post is purely temporary, for 11 months. The posts are on a purely temporary contract basis, and selected candidates have no right to claim regularisation of service. Selected candidates will be appointed as per G.O. content_sections.heading: About Mayiladuthurai DHS
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Mayiladuthurai functions under the Health and Family Welfare Department of Tamil Nadu and runs National Health Mission activities in Mayiladuthurai district. Its Chairman is the District Collector and its Executive Secretary is the District Health Officer, who signed this notice. The Staff Nurse posts are for CEmONC centres newly created under the Society, including their SNCU and PICU units.

content_sections.heading: Mayiladuthurai DHS Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Mayiladuthurai DHS has announced 56 Staff Nurse vacancies in total. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of the 56 posts.

content_sections.heading: Mayiladuthurai DHS Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council is compulsory. Candidates must already hold a Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Registration (TNNMC) certificate that is valid before the date on which the notice was published. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Staff Nurse post.

rows.qualification_required: Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or Bachelor's degree in Nursing (B.Sc, Nursing) from a Government or Government-recognised private nursing college recognised by the State Government.

content_sections.heading: Mayiladuthurai DHS Age Limit 2026

content_sections.heading: Mayiladuthurai DHS Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The notice describes the amount as a monthly consolidated pay (maadha thoguppoodhiyam) and does not mention any allowance on top of it.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mayiladuthurai DHS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for the Mayiladuthurai DHS Staff Nurse posts are offline only and must reach the District Health Office by 4 December 2026, 5:00 PM. Download the application form from the Mayiladuthurai District Collector website (mayiladuthurai.nic.in, Recruitment notice category). Attach copies of the documents listed below to the application. Send the application by Speed Post or Registered Post, or hand it in directly in person. Address the application to: District Health Office, 7th Floor, District Collectorate Complex, Mannampandal, Mayiladuthurai-609305. Make sure the application reaches the office between 20 November 2026 and 4 December 2026, 5:00 PM. 10th class mark sheet (SSLC Mark Sheet) 12th class mark sheet (HSC Mark Sheet) Degree/diploma mark sheet (GNM / B.Sc. Nursing Mark Sheet) Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Registration Certificate (a TNNMC certificate valid before the date of publication of the notice is compulsory) Community certificate Residence proof (Aadhaar card, family card, voter identity card) Transgender / Ex-servicemen / Destitute widow certificate (if any)

content_sections.heading: Mayiladuthurai DHS Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Staff Nurse post is purely temporary, for 11 months. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in Mayiladuthurai DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Mayiladuthurai DHS has announced 56 contract/temporary Staff Nurse posts for CEmONC centres, including SNCU and PICU, in Mayiladuthurai district.

faq.question: Q2. When does the Mayiladuthurai DHS Staff Nurse application start?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted from 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for Mayiladuthurai DHS Staff Nurse applications?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District Health Office, Mayiladuthurai by 4 December 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Mayiladuthurai DHS Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for Mayiladuthurai DHS Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a Government or Government-recognised private nursing college recognised by the State Government, with compulsory Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Mayiladuthurai DHS Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The Staff Nurse post carries a consolidated pay of Rs.21,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the Mayiladuthurai DHS application be sent?
faq.answer: Send it by Speed Post or Registered Post, or hand it in person, to the District Health Office, 7th Floor, District Collectorate Complex, Mannampandal, Mayiladuthurai-609305.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I get the Mayiladuthurai DHS Staff Nurse application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the Mayiladuthurai District Collector website, mayiladuthurai.nic.in, under its recruitment notices.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Mayiladuthurai DHS Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary for 11 months on a contract basis, and selected candidates have no right to claim regularisation.

faq.question: Q10. Is TNNMC registration required to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. A Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Registration (TNNMC) certificate valid before the date of publication of the notice is compulsory and must be enclosed with the application.
